author: Joseph Nguyen
hook: You don't have to believe every thought you have.

A thought said it's too late,
turn: Then I stopped arguing with them.
heading: Notice.

cover.label: A lesson from Don't Believe Everything You Think

caption:
Your mind will say a lot of things tonight. You don't have to believe all of them. 🖤
What's one thought you're done believing? Tell me below 👇
Save this for your next 2am spiral, or send it to someone who overthinks.
